newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica becomes mobile market leader.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica becomes mobile market leader.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana said on Tuesday its mobile telephone business had become market leader in its first year of competition, generating operating income of 258.91 billion pesetas ($1.8 billion) in 1996.

"Telefonica Moviles accounts for four in every five mobile telephone users out of a total of almost three million users, close to eight of every 100 Spaniards at the end of 1996," the company said in a statement.

Telefonica said it ended 1996 with 2.35 million active clients and a market share of around 80 percent. Of this, 1.31 million clients corresponded to its MoviLine service and 1.04 milion to its MoviStar business.

Its goals for the near future include extending its service to other areas of communication, including data and text, to increase productivity of its companies and increase its distribution in the residential market, it said.
The company said it had made some 140 billion pesetas of investments in its mobile business in 1996 and would invest a further 90 billion in 1997.
